input.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Meets the preferred position: Vendor IP indemnity covering Customer and Affiliates (20.1), plus breach of law, bodily injury/property damage, Customer Data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud (20.2); standard notice/cooperation/control procedure (20.4); procure-modify-replace-refund remedies (20.5); and Customer's indemnity narrowly limited to Customer-supplied material and Customer's violation of law (20.3). Indemnities also sit outside the liability cap as Excluded Claims.
